in_sanskrit.name: भर्गव
in_sanskrit.meaning: Bhar: to bear, give; gav: cow

in_hindi.long_meaning: भर-गव: The one who bears the cow

in_marathi.name: Bhargav
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Speech
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhargav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhargav is the name of Lord Vedavyasa, who is considered the author of the Mahabharata and the Bhagavad Gita. He is the god of speech, wisdom and knowledge.

in_bengali.name: Bhargav
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Speech
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhargav একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhargav is the name of Lord Vedavyasa, who is considered the author of the Mahabharata and the Bhagavad Gita. He is the god of speech, wisdom and knowledge.
